Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethLevDist --sample sample.tab,WT --outdir out --prefix dist --minDepth 1 --maxDepth 100 --binMethLev 0.5

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/LevDist.pm:

- keep records with 1 <= methylated + unmethylated <= 100;
- bin methylation levels by --binMethLev;
- use bin midpoints as output labels;
- emit zero-count bins for observed contexts;
- preserve integer percentage formatting.
